players.product: NdPr oxide and sintered NdFeB permanent magnets

quarterly_data.signal: MP Materials' 10-K customer concentration (customers not named): for 2025, Customers A and B in the Materials segment accounted for 30% and 23% of total revenue and Customer C, primarily in the Magnetics segment, for 31%; for 2024, Customers B and A in the Materials segment accounted for 78% and 20%; for 2023, Customer B accounted for 96%.
quarterly_data.figure: Customer A 30%, Customer B 23%, Customer C 31% (2025); Customer B 78%, Customer A 20% (2024); Customer B 96% (2023)

quarterly_data.signal: MP Materials' 10-K: sales of rare earth concentrate to China ceased in July 2025 to align with the DoW Transaction Agreements. Under the DoW Offtake Agreement MP anticipates that the DoW may become its largest customer of magnets, and that the DoW's obligations under the Price Protection Agreement and the Offtake Agreement may represent a significant source of revenue.

MP Materials' 10-K segment table for 2025 (in thousands): Materials revenue from external customers $157,580 plus price protection agreement income $51,016, Segment Adjusted EBITDA $16,818; Magnetics revenue $66,861, Segment Adjusted EBITDA $26,449. Segment capital expenditures were $92,249 for Materials and $79,772 for Magnetics; total 2025 capital expenditures $172,375 versus $186,418 in 2024.
quarterly_data.figure: Materials $157,580 thousand revenue + $51,016 thousand PPA income, Adjusted EBITDA $16,818 thousand; Magnetics $66,861 thousand, Adjusted EBITDA $26,449 thousand; capex $172,375 thousand (2024: $186,418 thousand)
